# 11\. Executive MBA in Switzerland for Indian Students

Executive MBA in Switzerland for Indian Students allows professionals to explore international management education and fortify their business knowledge. Frequently asked questions about the Executive MBA in Switzerland
Q1. Who is eligible to apply for an Executive MBA in Switzerland?
The Executive MBA is intended for experienced professionals, managers, entrepreneurs and executives who satisfy the institution’s educational and professional experience requirements.
Q2. How much does an Executive MBA cost in Switzerland?
Costs will differ depending on the business school and program format. Students should compare tuition fees, travel, accommodation and other additional costs before deciding.
Q3. Is it possible to do an Executive MBA while working full-time?
Many Executive MBA programs are designed for working professionals and are offered in modular, weekend, part-time or blended formats. This is dependent on the schedule of the institution.
Q4. What is the difference between an MBA and an Executive MBA?

While a traditional MBA might be the right fit for professionals at many points in their career journey, an Executive MBA is usually tailored to those who have a deeper well of professional experience and leadership responsibilities. This depends on the institution’s eligibility.
